errors.legacy: This is a Drifting 0.1 backup, which this version cannot restore directly. Restore it in Drifting 0.1, then import that library with “Import · Drifting 0.1” on the bookshelf.

update.install_failed: Drifting {{version}} couldn't be installed when you last quit. This version is unchanged; it tries again next time you quit.
update.install_failed_admin: Drifting {{version}} couldn't be installed when you last quit: the folder Drifting is in can't be written to. This version is unchanged.
update.interrupted: The update didn't finish downloading and was discarded. It downloads again at the next check.
update.local_error: The update couldn't be saved on this computer and was stopped. This version keeps working.
update.older_offered: You're up to date. The update service offers {{version}}, which is older than this version, so it won't be installed.
update.ready_on_quit: Drifting {{version}} is downloaded and its signature verified. It installs when you quit.
update.refused_app: The downloaded update isn't Drifting and was discarded. This version keeps working.
update.refused_signature: The downloaded update failed signature verification and was discarded. This version keeps working.
update.refused_version: The downloaded update isn't the version it claims to be, possibly an older one, and was refused. This version keeps working.
update.server_error: The update service has a problem right now. Try again later; this version keeps working.
